name: External Trade Transaction Condition 1 Code
definition: Specifies the external Trade Transaction Condition code in the format of character string with a maximum length of 4 characters.|The list of valid codes is an external code list published separately.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

BCBL.name: Board Lot
BCBL.definition: Board lots, not set for odd lots (UK specific).

BCBN.name: Bad Name
BCBN.definition: Bad names, not set for good names (UK specific).

BCFD.name: Delivery Form
BCFD.definition: Form of delivery, not for foreign registration when unset (UK specific).

BCPD.name: Deliver Country Incorporation
BCPD.definition: Place of delivery, in country of incorporation when unset (UK specific).

BCRO.name: Result Option
BCRO.definition: Result of option when set (UK specific).

BCRP.name: Result Repo
BCRP.definition: Result of repo when set (UK specific).

BLKO.name: Block
BLKO.definition: The trade is a block trade or not, ie, whether allocation instruction will follow or not.

BTEX.name: Best Execution
BTEX.definition: Trade to be executed done at best execution.

CALL.name: Call
CALL.definition: Trade to be executed following the exercise of a call option on the security.

CLBR.name: Closure Before Roll Over
CLBR.definition: Trade to be executed for closure of a previous position before the rollover of a position (Deferred Settlement Service).

CLEN.name: Clean
CLEN.definition: Trade is executed clean, ie government tax must not be paid on the accrued interest on the bond.

CRST.name: Cross Trade
CRST.definition: Cross trades are allowed whereby buy and sell orders are offset without recording the trade on the exchange

DIOR.name: Directed Order
DIOR.definition: Customer order where the customer gives specific instructions to the broker concerning the orders routing destination.

DIRT.name: Dirty
DIRT.definition: Trade is executed dirty, ie government tax must be paid on the accrued interest on the bond.

DORD.name: Direct Order
DORD.definition: Order is to be executed by a trading party other than the trading party to which the order is sent. In this case, the instructing party has traded with another broker which will subsequently send an advice of execution to the executing party who received the order and which is acting as clearing broker.

FORW.name: Forward Price Trade
FORW.definition: Order is based on a forward price.

GTDL.name: Guaranteed Delivery
GTDL.definition: Delivery of the financial instrument on settlement date is guaranteed.

HIST.name: Historic Price Trade
HIST.definition: Order is based on a historic price.

MAPR.name: Market Price
MAPR.definition: Trade was executed at market price.

MONT.name: Monthly
MONT.definition: Trade to be executed for month-end settlement (Deferred Settlement Service).

NBFR.name: New Trade Following Rollover
NBFR.definition: Trade to be executed for a new trade position on the next month following the roll-over of a position (Deferred Settlement Service).

NCRS.name: No Cross Trade
NCRS.definition: Cross trades, whereby buy and sell orders are offset without recording the trade on the exchange, are not allowed.

NEGO.name: Negotiated Trade
NEGO.definition: Trade for which the price is not the one quoted but an improved one, that is, the negotiated price.

NMPR.name: Non Market Price
NMPR.definition: Trade was executed outside of normal market conditions, for example, in the case of an iceberg order.

PETA.name: Pre Trade Anonimity
PETA.definition: Allows trader to explicitly request anonymity or disclosure in pre-trade market data feeds. Anonymity is relevant in markets where counterparties are regularly disclosed in order depth feeds. Disclosure is relevant when counterparties are not normally visible.

PUTT.name: Putt
PUTT.definition: Trade to be executed following the exercise of a put option on the security.

SETI.name: Sold Exempt
SETI.definition: Trade is exempt from short-sale rules.

SPCU.name: Special Cum Dividend
SPCU.definition: Trade is executed  with a special cum dividend, ie, buying after the ex date and getting the dividend.

SPEX.name: Special Ex Dividend
SPEX.definition: Trade is executed  with a special ex dividend, ie, selling before the ex date without the coupon.

SSTI.name: Sold Short
SSTI.definition: Trade is sold short. When the seller does not have the financial instrument, the delivery is effected by borrowing the financial instrument by or for the account of the seller.

TEFR.name: Trade Executed Following Rollover
TEFR.definition: Trade executed this month following the rollover of positions.

TRFR.name: Trade Following Rollover
TRFR.definition: Trade to be executed on the next month following the roll-over of positions.

WIBC.name: Before Auction
WIBC.definition: Transaction is before the issue date after announcement of the auction.

WICD.name: After Auction
WICD.definition: Transaction is after the issue date after announcement of the auction.
